dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Bzt! ♪ The open sky. The fresh air. The Pokémon. <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>It has
been a time since I saw them all.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>O céu aberto, o ar fresco, o Pokémon. <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Tem, sim.
Há muito tempo que não os via a todos.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Hello. Hello. Will you be a friend of mine? <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Let us
talk together.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Olá, quer ser meu amigo? <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Deixe-nos
Conversar juntos.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hello. Hello. There was a big building above here. Why is
it gone?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Olá, olá, havia aqui um grande edifício.
Desapareceu?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>It flew to the sky? It is difficult to believe.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Voou para o céu? É difícil acreditar.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Incredible. Those humans were making a thing of
amazement. <$voicel(1,8)>I now understand.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Incrível, aqueles humanos estavam a fazer uma coisa...
Espantoso. <$voicel(1,8)>Agora compreendo.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>There were many humans. They looked “sketchy.” They
did things around the building.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Havia muitos humanos. Eles pareciam “esquecados”.
fez coisas ao redor do prédio.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>One day, they disappeared. I went inside to investigate.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,8)>But I was unable to exit.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>Um dia, eles desapareceram, entrei para investigar.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas não consegui sair.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I could not exit and had no things to do, so I slept. How
long did I sleep? I do not know. <$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>When I woke, I was here.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu não podia sair e não tinha nada para fazer, então eu dormi.
Não sei. <$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Quando acordei, estava aqui.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>When the building flew, maybe I fell out.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Quando o edifício voou, talvez tenha caído.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>The building was a comfortable space for sleeping.
It would have been a good home. <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,2)>This is unfortunate.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>O edifício era um espaço confortável para dormir.
Teria sido uma boa casa. <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,2)>Isto é uma pena.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>You can make a home that is like the building. Is it
a possibility?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Você pode fazer uma casa que é como o edifício.
Uma possibilidade?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>If so, I would like that a large amount. Something like this.
Please make it.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Se sim, eu gostaria que uma grande quantidade. Algo como este.
Por favor, fá-lo.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,8)>I count on you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,8)>Conto com você.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>I wish for you to make my home.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu desejo que você faça a minha casa.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>You did it. You made my home. I thank you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Conseguiste, fizeste a minha casa.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wish to repay you. What can I do. I must think.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>O que posso fazer, devo pensar.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh. <$cdef(27)>. I have an idea. Do you
have
interest
in
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(13)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, sim. <$cdef(27)>Tenho uma ideia.
ter
juros
em
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(13)>?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>It will let you float around. This is very fun. You must try.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Isto vai deixar-te flutuar.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>. Your floating is skillful.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Ena. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>A tua flutuação é habilidosa.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>You must continue to practice. You will master
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(13)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Deve continuar a praticar.
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(13)>.
